name: Someya Yuka
source:
A female high school student. She was the target of a threat of someone claiming to be from Adonis.

Enomoto finds her wounded in an alleyway and takes her into police protection.

[From the [url=http://www.aksysgames.com/unlimited/characters/]official English website[/url]]
